title: Deployment Runbook
content:
# Deployment Runbook

## Overview
This document describes the standard deployment process for the platform.

## Steps
1. Build the Docker image
2. Push to the registry
3. Deploy to staging
4. Run smoke tests
5. Deploy to production

## Rollback
If something goes wrong, roll back to the previous version using the rollback script.

## Canary Deployment (NEW)
As of the latest revision, we now use canary deployment: deploy to 10% of traffic first, monitor for 5 minutes, then proceed to full rollout.
